description: CALL ... RETURNING status-item, ISO 14.9.4 - the RETURNING phrase is a 2002 introduction (folded from the inline CallBinder gate, Exec Step E).
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.4.2 (the RETURNING phrase on CALL is 2002+); §2023:14.9.4.4 GR4
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWCRET.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 RC PIC 99 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    CALL "RWCRSUB" RETURNING RC.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM RWCRET.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWCRSUB.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 LR PIC 99.
PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING LR.
MAIN.
    MOVE 5 TO LR.
    GOBACK.
END PROGRAM RWCRSUB.
